verdict.rationale: Snowflake is a cloud data platform with built-in AI features (Cortex AI Functions, Cortex Analyst, an MCP server), so a training-data privacy control is a fair question for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence pack says customer data is excluded from model training, or describes an opt-out or a contractual no-training commitment. The compliance certifications listed do not address AI training use, so the verdict is none.
